professionalProfile.title: Professional Profile
professionalProfile.description: Software engineer passionate about front-end development with React and back-end with Java (versions 8, 11, 17, 21), with strong experience in creating innovative digital solutions. Worked on complex projects from design to deployment, with expertise in modern technologies, agile development practices, and proven ability to solve high-level technical problems.

frontEndDevelopment.title: Front-End Development:
skills: Expertise in React (v18): Developing dynamic and responsive user interfaces.
Mastery of functional components, hooks, state management with Redux, and testing with React Testing Library.
Integration of REST APIs and web services with Axios and Fetch.
Use of TypeScript for static typing and improved code quality.

backEndDevelopment.title: Back-End Development:
skills: Strong skills in Java (v8, 11, 17, 21): Developing robust and scalable applications.
Experience with Spring Boot for creating microservices, data management with Spring Data JPA, and security with Spring Security.
Familiarity with RESTful architectures and good object-oriented programming (OOP) practices.
Use of frameworks like Hibernate for managing relational databases.

developmentTools.title: Development Tools:
skills: IntelliJ IDEA, Maven, Gradle, Git, Jenkins for continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD).
Use of Postman for REST API testing and Docker for application containerization.

databases.title: Databases:
skills: Mastery of database management systems Oracle PL/SQL, MySQL, SQL Server.
Experience with NoSQL databases like MongoDB and Redis.

otherSkills.title: Other Skills:
skills: Project Management and Agile Methodologies: Scrum, Trello.

experiences.description: Developed a front-end for a new platform with React (v18), improving user experience and functionalities. Created and maintained backend microservices in Java (v8 and 11) for property management. Supervised non-regression tests to ensure platform stability and reliability. Provided level 3 technical support to resolve complex issues.

experiences.position: Java/JEE Full Stack Developer (Internship) - Logima SARL, Oujda, Morocco
experiences.description: Designed and developed an e-commerce platform with PayPal SDK integration using Java (v8). Backend development with Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring Security. Used JSP for the front-end and version management with Git and Trello.

projects.title: Digital Project Management Web Application
projects.description: Developed a project management web application using Spring (REST Controller, Data JPA) and Vue.js for the front-end.

projects.title: E-News Web Application
projects.description: Developed an online news application with React for the front-end and Java (Spring, Hibernate) for the back-end.

projects.title: Development Infrastructure
projects.description: Set up a development infrastructure using open-source solutions (LDAP, DNS, GitLab, OwnCloud). Used Java for task automation and scripting.
